svg.title: SPI bus timing
svg.desc: SPI timing of the TLE92466ED in mode 1: CSN low frames a 32-bit frame, SO changes on each rising SCK edge and SI is read on each falling edge, with the lead, lag, setup, hold and output times the datasheet gives.
